items.name: Git on PATH
items.needed_for: working-tree snapshots, temp worktrees, base resolution, every diff-scoped check, hook identity
items.without: `adc.mjs` exits 3; QA modes cannot run; hooks emit `{}`

items.name: Node.js on PATH
items.needed_for: every script, every hook, the evidence ledger, `doctor`
items.without: guidance-only mode: the model follows the manual steps in `references/*.md` and says so in the ledger it writes by hand; hooks print `{}` (Copilot) or fail non-blocking (Claude, Codex)

items.name: A supported host with the skill installed in a directory it scans
items.without: nothing loads; pasting `SKILL.md` into the conversation (guidance-only) is the last resort

items.name: Permission to run `node` and `git` through the host's shell tool
items.without: a denied call leaves the step `UNVERIFIED`; headless runs need explicit grants

items.name: A writable, git-excluded state directory (`.adc/`)
items.needed_for: state, evidence, hook records, live credentials and the budget ledger
items.without: CLI commands exit 3 while `.adc/` is tracked by git; hooks keep emitting `{}`; relocate with `ADC_HOME` or `--state-dir`

items.name: For QA modes: a Git repository with a resolvable base and enough history
items.without: base chain `--base` > `origin/HEAD` > `main`/`master`/`init.defaultBranch` > `HEAD`; shallow clones get "run `git fetch --unshallow`" (exit 4)

items.name: Node reachable by the host's hook launcher
items.fallback: `setup hooks --node-path` renders the absolute Node path; `doctor` probes every launcher and reports a dead hook instead of hiding it

items.name: Hooks registered via `setup hooks`
items.needed_for: session brief, post-edit warnings, observed runs, completion notice or gate
items.fallback: every mode works without hooks; the ledger is the source of truth

items.name: `ADC_LIVE_TOKEN` in `.adc/.env.live` or the environment
items.fallback: live probes refuse to run (`UNVERIFIED: ADC_LIVE_TOKEN unset`); every other mode is unaffected

items.name: `.adc/budget.json` (budget ledger)
items.needed_for: spend cap for live probes (2,500 credits per session and per day by default)
items.fallback: materialized from the shipped template on first use; without registered hooks every run is its own session, so only the daily cap spans runs

items.name: `ADC_DEBUG=1`
items.fallback: terse logging

items.name: GitHub CLI (`gh skill`, public preview)
items.fallback: `npx skills add ... --copy`; `copilot skill add <clone>/skills`; Codex `$skill-installer`; `git clone --depth 1` plus copy or junction

items.name: Vercel `skills` CLI (`npx skills`, Node 22.20+)
items.fallback: any other install path

items.name: Codex `$skill-installer`
items.needed_for: install from inside Codex (runs a Python script; needs a network escalation in the sandbox)
items.fallback: `gh skill install ... --agent codex`; clone and copy into `~/.agents/skills/`

items.name: Copilot `copilot skill add <dir>` or `skillDirectories`
items.fallback: copy the folder into `~/.copilot/skills/`

items.name: Network access to github.com at install and update time
items.fallback: vendor the skill into the work repo (pinned to tag + SHA) or copy it by hand; the cloud agent clones it in `copilot-setup-steps.yml`

items.name: gitleaks or trufflehog
items.fallback: built-in secret regexes on the snapshot including untracked files (findings still FAIL; more false positives)

items.name: diff-cover (Python)
items.fallback: built-in diff mapping for coverage XML/LCOV, Jest/Vitest JSON, go cover, coverlet; file-level results labeled approximate; coverage stays a soft check

items.name: StrykerJS, Stryker.NET, cargo-mutants, mutmut (POSIX only)
items.fallback: skipped and recorded in the ledger; verdict unaffected

items.name: pytest-randomly + pytest-repeat, jest-circus (`--randomize`), Go 1.17+ (`-shuffle`), cargo-nextest
items.fallback: N sequential runs with `shuffle: false`; plain `cargo test` parser; `retries_disabled: unknown` recorded

items.name: Lint-side detectors (eslint-plugin-jest, Vitest `allowOnly`, pytest `-rs`, ESLint unused-directive reports, ruff `RUF100`, mypy `warn_unused_ignores`)
items.fallback: built-in anchored regexes on added lines with the base-tree ratchet

items.name: Package-registry access (`npm view`, `pip index versions`, `cargo info`, `go list -m`)
items.fallback: offline-first: lockfile, then cached registry metadata; `--offline` is the default under Codex

items.name: A host fresh-context reviewer (Claude subagent, Copilot `/review` or a custom agent, `codex review`)
items.fallback: the model opens a new conversation with `references/review.md`; unconfirmed criticals never fail the verdict

items.name: Host security reviewers (`/security-review`, `claude-security`, Copilot code review)
items.fallback: none: FM-10 stays uncovered and the ledger says so

items.name: Playwright (with browsers), Playwright MCP, `npx playwright init-agents`
items.fallback: templates rendered without the agents or MCP; browsers installed by the scaffold's documented step

items.name: Schemathesis, Pact
items.fallback: omitted when there is no OpenAPI document or no second service

items.name: Snapshot and approval libraries, HTTP mocks and fake timers
items.fallback: runner-native snapshots or golden files; fix patterns are recommended, not installed

items.name: GitHub Actions (`dorny/paths-filter`, a JUnit reporter action, `actions/setup-node` pinned to 24)
items.fallback: GitHub Actions first; notes only for GitLab CI and Azure Pipelines

items.name: Dependency audit tools (`npm audit`, `pip-audit`, `cargo audit`, `dotnet list package --vulnerable`)
items.fallback: non-blocking by default; omitted for stacks without a tool

items.name: External validators (`skills-ref validate`, `claude plugin validate`, `gh skill publish --dry-run`, `copilot skill list --json`, `codex exec --strict-config`, `waza`)
items.fallback: the built-in Node validator always runs; external results are merged only when the tool is installed

items.name: `claude plugin eval`, promptfoo, Waza, a headless host CLI on PATH
items.needed_for: `tooling eval`, `tooling trigger-set`, the skill's own evals
items.fallback: the trigger set is generated without a runner; evals are marked manual and paid

items.name: Claude `/skill-doctor`, `/doctor prompt-audit`, `claude --debug`; Copilot `/env`, `/skills info`
items.needed_for: diagnostics referenced by `tooling optimize` and host notes
items.fallback: `doctor` and `tooling cost` are the skill's own equivalents

items.name: `.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml`
items.needed_for: cloning the skill for the cloud agent outside the Bash-tool firewall
items.fallback: vendor the skill into the repo

items.name: CODEOWNERS and branch protection on `.github/hooks/**` and vendored skill directories
items.fallback: none; a recommendation, not a mechanism

items.name: PowerShell 7 (`pwsh`)
items.needed_for: Copilot CLI and Codex hooks on Windows
items.fallback: Windows PowerShell 5.1 (collapses exit codes and re-encodes stdout; harmless because decisions are ASCII JSON on exit 0)

items.name: Git for Windows (Git Bash) for Claude Code
items.needed_for: Claude Code's Bash tool on Windows
items.fallback: Claude's PowerShell tool; `CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH` when Git Bash is not auto-detected; exec-form hooks need no Git Bash

items.name: `core.longpaths` for deep temp worktrees
items.fallback: a clear `UNVERIFIED` reason instead of a path-length failure

items.name: WSL2
items.fallback: run those on macOS or Linux; everything else is native

items.name: Copilot CLI
items.needed_for: skills, hooks, `copilot skill list --json` (namespaced skills, `copilot skill add`; `exec` hooks documented 1.0.97)
items.fallback: another host, or guidance-only mode

items.name: VS Code
items.needed_for: skills (GA in 1.109), hooks (Preview; Session Target = Copilot)
items.fallback: another host, or guidance-only mode

items.name: Claude Code
items.fallback: older versions run the skill and hooks; evals are marked manual

items.name: Codex
items.fallback: older versions run the skill without hooks
